Harrison Santiago is a Private Client Specialist with UWIB Risk & Insurance Solutions, focused on delivering clear, practical guidance in personal lines insurance. He works closely with clients to simplify complex coverage decisions and help them make informed insurance choices, taking a client-first approach rooted in transparency and efficiency. Harrison began his career in client-facing roles where he developed a strong foundation in communication, problem-solving, and relationship management. Known for his ability to connect with clients and translate technical details into real-world understanding, he emphasizes clarity, responsiveness, and trust in every interaction. He takes pride in helping clients feel confident in their coverage decisions, especially in situations where thoughtful guidance can make a meaningful difference in both protection and long-term value. Outside of work, Harrison has a deep interest in music composition, personal style inspired by Italian sprezzatura, and horology. He also enjoys traveling and experiencing different cultures, which continues to shape his perspective both personally and professionally.
